subject: Compliance add-ons commercial path and concession proposal
messages:
From: Mike Lawson <mike.lawson@vitahealth.com>

Cc: Susan Cho <susan.cho@vitahealth.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance add-ons — structure + ask

Tessa,

Thanks for taking time earlier. We ran the compliance economics internally and have three priorities: immutable audit logs (30d vs 365d retention options), HSM-backed KMS for key custody (we expect ~8 production HSM seats at go-live), and EU data residency for a subset of PHI traffic.

Two asks from procurement/legal: 1) a clear pricing model we can plug into a PO (line items + unit economics), and 2) any volume or pilot credits you can offer — our legal lead is sensitive to upfront commitments.

Can you send a concrete commercial path (pilot pricing + steady-state) and any concessions you might consider for a 12-month committed usage? We aim to finalize terms with our CFO by 5/28.

Appreciate it,
Mike

--
Mike Lawson
Head of Procurement, VitaHealth

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-05-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — structure + ask

Mike — thanks, this is helpful context. High level proposal below; attaching the pricing workback and an SOW draft for implementation timing. Internal team, I’ve looped you for pricing and approval notes.

Proposal summary (pilot -> steady state):
- Pilot (3 months): 40% off list for audit logs and HSM seats; pilot capped at 75M audit-events/month and 4 HSM seats. Goal: validate throughput, retention, and key rotation process.
- Steady state (post-pilot):
  - Audit logs: base $0.25 per 1k events for 30d retention; incremental +$0.04/1k for 365d storage. Tiered step-down at 500M/mo and 2B/mo.
  - HSM/KMS: $1,200/month per HSM seat (includes 24/7 access + key-rotation support); volume discount applied at >=10 seats. Overage model available for short spikes.
  - Residency: Dedicated EU tenancy as a fixed monthly fee: $28k/month for the dedicated tenancy + regional egress at normal rates.
  - HIPAA bundle (optional): $15k/month includes BAA, quarterly review, and 24/7 on-call support for incident triage.

Concessions proposed for a 12-month commit: one-time credit equal to 10% of first-year committed addon spend (applied as monthly credits), and a rolling refund on unused HSM seats after 6 months (credit for seats not provisioned by month end).

Next steps: Ben/Marissa/Aditya — please sanity-check numbers and the concession framework (esp the rolling HSM seat credit). Mike/Susan — if this looks directionally OK, I’ll produce a PO-ready line-item table and a DocuSign stub.

Thanks,
Tessa
--
Tessa Morgan
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-17T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — structure + ask

Agree with the structure, a few suggested refinements from pricing ops (see attached workback):
- Audit events: change base to $0.20/1k for 30d retention if they commit to a 12-month minimum of >=150M/mo average. This gives procurement a clear target and makes the step-down predictable.
- Add a storage-only SKU for long-tail (365d) at $0.03/1k when driven to cold storage after 90 days — lowers steady state cost for large retention customers.
- HSM: propose seat + hourly consumption blend for heavy key ops (e.g., signature bursts). Seat remains $1,050/mo for >=8 seats on a 12-month commitment; one-time provisioning fee waived for the pilot.
- Residency: offer a phase-in discount — first 3 months of dedicated tenancy at 50% off if they sign the 12-month tenancy within pilot. That helps procurement with cashflow.

I put numbers in vitahealth_pricing_workback.xlsx and modeled net present value vs list. If Tessa approves, we can offer this as the commercial fallback; it buys them runway and protects our margin on sustained usage.

Ben

Subject: Re: Compliance add-ons — structure + ask

Tessa/Ben — a couple practical points before we present to VitaHealth legal: 
- Legal will push for a termination-for-convenience credit on prepaid dedicated tenancy; recommend we offer a pro-rata refund less a 2-month minimal termination fee.
- For the HSM seat credit — make it explicit in the SOW that seat provisioning is admin-triggered by VitaHealth (so we can guarantee the unused-seat credit).
- Approvals: I can approve up to 25% off list on the pilot line items; for anything beyond that (e.g., Ben’s $1,050 HSM seat or deeper residency concession) we should loop Aditya for one-off credit authorization.

I’ve also drafted a short PO-ready table we can attach to the DocuSign that lists the pilot line items, renewal pricing, and the credit mechanics.

Marissa

Mike / Susan — thanks for the patience while we pulled internal approvals. Below is a compact commercial path we can put on a PO plus the pilot concession we can commit to today. Attached: VitaHealth_SOW_draft.pdf and the pricing_workback for details. We’ll open a DocuSign once you confirm the PO table.

Agreed commercial path (summary):
- Pilot (3 months): 40% off list for audit logs and HSM seats; pilot limits: 75M audit events/month, 4 HSM seats. Provisioning fee waived.
- If VitaHealth signs a 12-month commitment within pilot window:
  - Audit logs: $0.20/1k events for 30d retention (>=150M/mo committed avg); 365d cold storage at $0.03/1k after 90 days.
  - HSM/KMS: $1,050/mo per seat for >=8 seats committed for 12 months. Unused-seat credits: refundable monthly if seat not provisioned by end of billing month (per SOW).
  - Dedicated EU residency: $28k/month list; first 3 months at 50% off if tenancy is committed as part of the 12-month agreement.
  - HIPAA bundle: $15k/month optional.
- Concessions: One-time first-year credit = 10% of committed addon spend (applied monthly); Marissa authorized up to 25% pilot discount; Aditya will review any extra one-time credits beyond that.

Action items for VitaHealth:
1) Confirm you want the pilot with the proposed caps.
2) Share PO contact and send a draft PO by 5/28 for CFO review.
3) If yes, we’ll send a DocuSign with PO-ready line items + SOW link (DocuSign link below).

DocuSign (preview): https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/VH-2027-0009
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-vitahealth-pricing

If that aligns, I’ll have the DocuSign out today and Marissa will provision the first-month credit on execution.

Thanks — looking forward to getting VitaHealth on pilot.
